title: Workbench ML Signal Manifest
description: Batch manifest for a set of ML signals written in one production run. Lists all signal files, their types, and the common source_release they share.

source_release.description: Harvester release ID shared by all signals in this manifest.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when this manifest was written.

path.description: Relative path to the signal JSON file from the manifest's directory.

pollution_check.description: Most recent result from the ML integrity pollution monitor.
